ko.executive_summary: TSMC is targeting 100,000 monthly wafers for its 2nm process by end-2026 driven by NVIDIA and AMD demand acceleration. MediaTek is adopting Intel EMIB-T alongside TSMC CoWoS for AI chips, while LB Semicon secured Qualcomm mass production approval and begins AI/automotive back-end processing in August.
key_facts: TSMC 2nm target: 100,000 monthly wafers by end-2026
LB Semicon: Qualcomm mass production approval, AI and automotive chip back-end processing begins August
MediaTek: Adopts Intel EMIB-T and TSMC CoWoS for AI chips

implications.text: NVIDIA and AMD are forcing foundry capacity expansion; TSMC ramping 2nm production ahead of previous expectations to maintain supply chain leadership.
MediaTek's dual adoption of Intel EMIB-T and TSMC CoWoS signals strategic hedging of chiplet/HBM integration approaches for competitive AI products.

ko.counterpoint: Achieving 100,000 wafers/month at 2nm requires sustained yield improvements and equipment availability; delays in either could slip the timeline.
